chapter: Russell's band, records and Armstrong in the studio
title: Audiences at the Savoy and the Lindy Hop
summary: Audiences of all ages and races came, and the young crowd did the new Lindy Hop named for Lindbergh's flight.

story.theme_name: Playing for dancers: dance bands and the dances themselves
story.community_name: Dancing to the band: quadrilles, waltzes and dance sets

blocks.x: Well, any kind. Any kind that wanted to come. We had all kind of audiences. Black audiences, White audiences...

Well, the age groups were young and.... We got up until 85 years old. Seen them out on the floor dancing. Yeah, there some old folks out there, too. Them old ones could dance just as good as the young ones. They were dancin' and cuttin' up.
But what I wondered is, was it the music of the young people? Because for instance...
This was the young people. We were the young people.
Heh-heh-heh. Yeah, it was their music.
Oh yeah. Because when we went to work at the Savoy Ballroom, at that time they had a dance which was just created called the Lindy-Hop -- you know?

Boy, they were cuttin' them rugs, and one thing and another... Because you know, Lindbergh had just made his flight to Europe, and they had taken the name Lindy Hop, and it was this dance... And boy, the way they was throwin' their partners around and lifting them up in the air, and doin' all that gymnastics stuff and one thing and another...
